JontaiEnergy.

A clear, responsive solar energy website built to help visitors discover sustainable energy solutions and get in touch.

Energy made easier to explore.

Jontai Energy presents sustainable energy in a direct, approachable way. The page is designed to introduce the company, guide visitors through its services, and make requesting a quote feel effortless.

I built the site with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, focusing on responsive layouts, clear navigation, and a visual language that fits a modern solar energy business.
